question_text: A bill seeking to increase the penalty for illegal logging has been approved by both the House of Representatives and the Senate. However, the President vetoes the bill. Which of the following steps must Congress take to override the President's veto?

options.text: Congress must re-pass the bill by a two-thirds vote of all its members in both houses, voting separately.
Congress must re-pass the bill by a majority vote of all its members in a joint session.
Congress must re-pass the bill by a three-fourths vote of all its members in both houses, voting separately.
Congress must re-pass the bill by a two-thirds vote of the members present in each house, voting separately.
